overview: A real-time monitoring dashboard for an ESP32 sensor rig that displays live temperature, humidity, and gas readings with Stable, Warning, and Unstable status indicators.
features: Live temperature, gas, and humidity readouts that update automatically
Stable, Warning, and Unstable status badges for each sensor
Overall system status banner showing the worst current reading
Live trend chart plotting all three sensors over time
Simple, high-contrast layout for at-a-glance monitoring
